edits.text: PARTIES. This Lease is between Calder Properties as Landlord and [Tenant’s full legal name, entity type, and jurisdiction of organization—to be confirmed] as Tenant.
2. RENT. The Tenant shall pay monthly Base Rent of USD [amount to be agreed by the parties].
3. TERM. The lease term is sixty months commencing on [date to be agreed by the parties] (the “Commencement Date”).

4. ASSIGNMENT. The Tenant shall not assign this Lease without the Landlord’s prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed. No consent shall be required for an assignment to an affiliate of the Tenant or to a successor in connection with a merger or sale of substantially all the Tenant’s business, provided that the Tenant gives the Landlord written notice and reasonable supporting documentation before the assignment (or promptly afterward if prior notice is prohibited by law), and the assignee assumes in writing all obligations of the Tenant under this Lease, except to the extent such assumption occurs by operation of law. “Affiliate” means an entity controlling, controlled by, or under common control with the Tenant. No assignment shall release the Tenant from its obligations under this Lease without the Landlord’s express written agreement.
